implementation: Added --no-interactive and kept it active through TTY, workbench, and preview readiness paths.

m-model completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|elvish> emits dynamic shell registration using clap_complete 4.6.12 unstable-dynamic; it registers from the live public Clap tree before Python/environment initialization.

Component ID and exact-version candidates now read only the current project static manifest registry for component show/check/test/uninstall, Layer add/replace, and Assembly add/set. The completer does not import or execute project Python.
Hidden internal-run is parsed by a dedicated early parser and is absent from the public command tree.

Schema candidates now cover `component test --param`, registered Layer add/replace with `--component`, and component-backed Assembly add/set. Names and simple scalar enum/const values come only from the selected static manifest; explicit versions are exact, unversioned references use the highest registered SemVer. Completion is validated in the live Clap shell path and returns before Python runtime selection.

Schema candidates now also cover named root-model injections using --inject SLOT=component:ID@VERSION and --inject-param SLOT.NAME=JSON; non-component Python factories remain unsupported for static candidate discovery.

Schema-backed parameter completion now includes bounded whole-JSON candidates for explicit enum values of any supported JSON type, and composes nested required object fields only when each field has a declared enum/default. It does not guess values for arbitrary Python factories or synthesize partial JSON fragments.

Added live Clap-tree help/capability checks: every public subcommand and named option must have a human description; every operation_catalog current_cli path resolves against the actual command tree; catalog entries declare python_worker or rust_cli ownership; worker-owned entries must name a registered compatibility operation. Corrected inspect_component to the Rust-owned path rather than mislabeling it as a worker operation.

integration_patch: Cli.no_interactive is threaded into terminal::is_interactive and ApplicationUiServices readiness handling; run_command and no-command workbench startup both honor it.
The no-command interactive workbench startup also checks no_interactive, so explicitly non-interactive users receive normal help instead of entering the menu.
Hidden InternalRun was removed from the public Clap Command enum and parsed by a separate early internal-run parser; detached training supervision integration remains passing.
Shell completion generator runs before Python runtime selection and writes only the script to stdout; supported shell list is explicit and validated by Clap.
remaining: Native Fish, PowerShell and Elvish loading tests remain unverified: command -v found only /usr/bin/bash and /usr/bin/zsh in this environment. Their setup text is covered by generator tests; Bash and Zsh have current-tree live shell smoke evidence.
limitations: Static completion does not execute arbitrary Python factories and does not guess unregistered model/batch parameters or free-form JSON fragments; candidates are bounded whole values from declared schema enum/defaults.
Operation parity is checked for every operation_catalog entry; utility commands remain Rust-owned/help-described and are not misrepresented as worker operations.
